split_policy.primary_axis: planning-checkbox policy behavior before fixture directory label, markdown heading label, JSON policy row, file path convenience, runbook prose, generated row, report row, old-mode label, gate label, retired route label, compatibility label, or migration label
split_policy.positive_rule: planning-checkbox positives are limited to hand-authored fixtures where an unchecked markdown checklist row is explicitly permitted by an allowed_unchecked_sections policy entry matching the document path and heading section
split_policy.canonical_rejection_rule: unchecked planning rows without policy, section mismatch rows, stale/unused policy entries, mixed-policy directories with any unallowed unchecked implementation row, generated-only rows, evidence-log rows, migration-only rows, old-mode rows, gate rows, retired route rows, and compatibility rows are non-positive rejection or provenance evidence
split_policy.strict_error_rule: unchecked implementation rows without policy exceptions, policy entries that do not match the checked section, unused policy entries when no unchecked row remains, and mixed JSON/markdown rows where only one document is allowed own fail-closed strict-error evidence
split_policy.provenance_rule: JSON policy files, markdown fixture files, fixture directory names, path labels, section labels, reason text, checklist text, scenario names, and owner-split routing rows remain provenance unless e2e/tooling or rejection owners claim the behavior boundary
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: old-mode planning policy, gate planning policy, retired route planning policy, compatibility planning policy, migration-only rows, generated-only rows, evidence-log rows, stale policy positives, unchecked-row positives without policy, runner-only success, workflow-label-only success, wrapper-only planning checks, and generated/report rows promoted as support are canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
